comment: The settings in the Settings window (guide ch.33) and the options of their dialog boxes, with the pages they come from. scope: project, user. Option types: bool, int, choice (style radio or menu), timecode, text, info (read-only), drive (a media drive, filled in when the dialog opens; empty for the one with the most space). A setting with 'opens' has no dialog: double-clicking it opens that tool (the Tool Palette, p.392, p.1221). 'later' options are shown but cannot be changed yet; their feature comes in a later phase. Defaults the guide does not give are ours.
